title: あなたが輝くステージを

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've decided to rethink our entire project, which means going back to the basics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After talking it out, we come to the realization that conveying emotions like gratitude isn't a one-way street—the fans' voices matter too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello once wished for nothing more than to see her dear idol shine. She needed the Grand Concert—not as a runner, but as a fan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what exactly about the Grand Concert speaks so deeply to fans like her? That's the question we now need to answer.
